sourceNotes: The official cannabis homepage moved from mtrevenue.gov/cannabis/ to https://revenue.mt.gov/card/cannabis/, walked on 2026-09-08. This host is the Department of Revenue Cannabis and Alcohol Regulation Division. The FAQ at /card/cannabis/faqs answers adult possession, adult purchase, adult and medical home cultivation, and the public-consumption ban. Cardholder Information answers medical dispensary purchase. Know Before You Go answers cardholder possession limits. The 2026 visitor checklist at /ResponsibilityMatters/2026/cannabis-checklist names parks, sidewalks, and hotels as public use. Know Before You Grow restates adult and cardholder plant counts and that a caregiver may cultivate for a cardholder. The old mtrevenue.gov/cannabis/cardholders/ path is a 404. Citations that had been on revenuefiles.mt.gov and leg.mt.gov were replaced because those hosts are not the requested source and this host already answers the questions. Fetch with browser headers returns 200 and the excerpts are in the HTML, so these rows do not need a browser.
